activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Sessions where Mockingbird logged what you worked on.
activity.beta.label: BETA
activity.beta.heading: Beta — proven concept, not yet release-grade.
activity.beta.body: Mockingbird is capturing activity events and assembling timeline blocks. The remaining gap to call this stable is the granularity of task-level recording — distinguishing meaningful work-units from incidental focus changes well enough to produce a quality summary. Improvements landing iteratively.

dictations.llm.notRun: Pick a prompt and click Run to summarize, extract action items, or clean up the punctuation. Output is held in memory only — it never touches the saved transcript.

modes.title: Modes
modes.subtitle: Pick which transcription mode Right-Alt uses. AI command modes are separate — enable the ones you want and they get their own hotkey.
modes.section.transcription.help: Exactly one is active. Right-Alt always uses the selected mode.
modes.section.commands.help: Act on selected or clipboard text. Each has its own hotkey when enabled.
modes.desc.casual: For chats and messages. Tightens phrasing while keeping your natural voice — contractions and slang welcome, lists stay inline as prose.
modes.desc.normal: For email and docs. Balanced, polished prose. Renders bulleted or numbered lists when you explicitly ask for them.
modes.desc.formal: For reports, notes, and structured writing. Register-lifted output with headers, bullets, and numbered steps where appropriate.
modes.desc.rewrite: Edits the selected (or clipboard) text in place. Preserves meaning, improves clarity and flow.
modes.desc.expand: Turns a terse note or fragment into a fuller paragraph. Useful for fleshing out outlines.
modes.desc.summarize: Condenses a long block of text into a few sentences. Keeps the key points, drops the rest.
modes.field.model.help: Pick from your local Ollama installs, or type any tag. Cloud providers ignore this list.
modes.field.model.empty: No local Ollama models detected — Ollama may not be running.
settings.title: Settings
kg.settings.title: Knowledge Graph
kg.settings.explainer: Knowledge Graph indexes your dictations so you can search and filter by entities, tags, and categories. Default off — no data is indexed until you turn it on.
kg.settings.enabled.label: Enable Knowledge Graph indexing
kg.settings.notice.title: Indexing in progress
kg.settings.notice.body: Newly recorded dictations are indexed within about a minute. Existing dictations from before you enabled this won’t be indexed until a future update.
kg.status.title: Filing status
kg.failed.heading: Failed filings
settings.general.sound.help: Soft chirp on start, gentle tick on done. Off by default.
settings.general.reducedMotion.help: Disables waveform animation, slide-in, and pulses. Honors system preference automatically.
settings.general.cmdCenterChord.help: Global chord that opens the Command Center. Format: <modifier>+<key>, e.g. RightCtrl+Space.
settings.activity.audio.help: When enabled, Activity sessions also record your microphone and system audio for per-block transcription. Off by default; everything stays local.
settings.meeting.legacyChord.help: When enabled, the meeting chord starts/stops a meeting directly without opening the Command Center.
settings.general.bg.title: Background photo
settings.general.bg.help: Display a slowly-panning photo from Unsplash behind the app. Rotates every 5 minutes. Your API key is stored locally on this machine.
settings.general.bg.enabled.needsKey: Add your Unsplash API key below to enable.
settings.general.bg.apiKey.help: Free from unsplash.com/developers. Demo keys give 50 requests/hour — enough for our 5-minute rotation.
settings.general.bg.categories.help: Pick one or more. The app picks a random photo from one of your selected categories each rotation.
settings.models.ollama.help: Ollama runs on your machine. Models live in your local Ollama install.
settings.models.claude.configured: API key configured — stored in Windows DPAPI.
settings.history.audioRetention.help: Off by default. Stores raw WAV in your data directory if on.
settings.history.purge.confirm: This deletes every dictation, transcript, and correction. It cannot be undone. Type PURGE to confirm.
settings.dictation.cleanup.scope: Controls how the dictation pipeline polishes what you dictate. Doesn’t affect Rewrite, Expand, or other on-demand transforms.
settings.dictation.cleanup.level.none.de: Raw transcription. No cleanup, no filler removal, no LLM. Fastest.
settings.dictation.cleanup.level.light.d: Deterministic cleanup only. Strips fillers, fixes punctuation, no LLM. ~5 ms.
Adds punctuation and structure with an LLM, preserves every word. ~1–3 s.
settings.dictation.cleanup.level.high.de: Full register-aware cleanup with an LLM. ~1–3 s. Current default.
settings.dictation.cleanup.preferQ5.desc: Better cleanup quality at the cost of ~500 MB additional VRAM. Recommended if your GPU has more than 6 GB.
settings.dictation.cleanup.preferQ5.vram: Detected: {mib} MiB VRAM — this option may not work reliably.
settings.dictation.activation.inApp.valu: Use the Dictate button on the Dictations page.
settings.dictation.activation.note: Hotkey customisation is planned for a future release.
settings.dictation.perMode.desc: Model, temperature, and max-tokens are configured per tone (Casual / Normal / Formal) on the Modes page.
settings.advanced.learning.help: Nightly job that classifies your corrections and improves the dictionary + style examples. Rolls back automatically on regression.
settings.advanced.telemetry: This app sends no data to Anthropic or to us. Everything is local. Crash logs stay on this machine.
about.title: About Mockingbird
about.tagline: Local-first, system-wide voice dictation. Your transcripts never leave your machine.
nestedVault.title: Vault location concern
nestedVault.body.intro: The folder you picked is inside an existing Obsidian vault:
nestedVault.body.risk: Both vaults would try to manage the same .obsidian/ configuration, which can cause sync conflicts and unexpected file rewrites.
nestedVault.sibling.title: Use a sibling location instead (recommended)
